description: This file exports constants and a module object that includes functions and data structures for a Git graph visualization tool. It appears to define a module for rendering Git commit history diagrams, with functions for creating branches, merging, cherry-picking, and rendering visual elements using SVG.

methods.name: setDirection
methods.description: Sets the direction of the Git diagram rendering (e.g., LR for left-to-right).

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Parses and sets configuration options for the diagram rendering.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns current configuration options.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified message, type, and tags, and associates it with the current branch.

methods.name: branch
methods.description: Creates a new branch with a specified name, if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another branch into the current branch, with optional custom type and ID.

methods.name: cherryPick
methods.description: Cherry-picks a commit into the current branch.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Switches to a specified branch.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Outputs the current commit graph visually in console or logs.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the commit and branch data.

methods.name: getBranchesAsObjArray
methods.description: Returns an array of branch objects with name and order.

methods.name: getBranches
methods.description: Returns current branch mappings.

methods.name: getCommits
methods.description: Returns the commit objects map.

methods.name: getCommitsArray
methods.description: Returns an array of all commits.

methods.name: getCurrentBranch
methods.description: Returns the name of the current branch.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns current diagram direction (e.g., LR).

methods.name: getHead
methods.description: Returns the current head commit object.

methods.name: setAccTitle
methods.description: Sets the accessibility title.

methods.name: getAccTitle
methods.description: Gets the accessibility title.

methods.name: getAccDescription
methods.description: Gets the accessibility description.

methods.name: setAccDescription
methods.description: Sets the accessibility description.

methods.name: setDiagramTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the diagram.

methods.name: getDiagramTitle
methods.description: Gets the diagram title.

methods.name: commitType
methods.description: Enumeration for commit types: NORMAL, REVERSE, HIGHLIGHT.
